title: Native Rust + Tauri v2, Frosted Glass & External Game HUD
notes: Native Rust + Tauri v2 runtime, real-time Gaussian frosted glass with Classic Bezel & Floating Island styles, anti-cheat safe Game Stats HUD, hardware Volume HUD, multi-file drag-and-drop batch converter, smarter YouTube & web search routing, and expanding multi-line dictation captions.

highlights.title: Native Rust + Tauri v2 Runtime
highlights.detail: Replaced the legacy Electron layer with a fast, low-memory native Windows runtime and instant standalone Settings window.

highlights.title: Real-Time Frosted Glass & Dual Notch Styles
highlights.detail: Switch between Classic Bezel and Floating Island with live Gaussian-blurred backdrop glass, custom tint opacity, and crisp GPU concave arches.

highlights.title: Anti-Cheat Safe Game Stats HUD & Focus Shield
highlights.detail: External read-only FPS, frametime sparkline, GPU, CPU, RAM, and ping HUD with automatic hotkey protection and click-through while gaming.

highlights.title: Multi-File Drag-and-Drop Batch Converter
highlights.detail: Drop one or multiple files directly onto the top notch to queue and convert them in batch while keeping every original file untouched.

highlights.title: Smart Web Search & Expanding Dictation
highlights.detail: Direct YouTube, Google, Reddit, and platform searches open straight in your browser, and dictation/voice boxes now auto-expand smoothly across multiple lines.

releases.title: Native Rust + Tauri v2, Frosted Glass & External Game HUD
releases.summary: Full migration to native Rust + Tauri v2 with real-time frosted glass, Classic & Floating notch modes, external Game Stats HUD, hardware Volume HUD, multi-file batch conversion, smart web search routing, and expanding voice captions.

highlights.title: Native Rust + Tauri v2 Architecture
highlights.detail: Compact 3.1 MB installer, minimal 3-step onboarding, reliable always-on-top launch, per-app Windows media volume control, full PDF/OCR-to-Word conversion with Arabic RTL support, and zero WebView2 microphone permission popups.

highlights.title: Classic Bezel & Floating Island Frosted Glass
highlights.detail: Live native Gaussian-blurred glass with razor-sharp GPU-masked concave arches, adjustable tint %, and Smooth / Snappy / Bouncy motion curves.

highlights.title: External Game Stats HUD & Gaming Focus Shield
highlights.detail: 100% read-only FPS, frametime graph, RTX/GPU temp & VRAM, CPU, RAM, and network ping with automatic hotkey pause during gameplay.

highlights.title: Multi-File Drag-and-Drop & Smart Search
highlights.detail: Drop multiple files onto the notch for batch conversion, get instant browser searches for YouTube & Google, and read full multi-line dictation captions without clipping.

releases.title: ElevenLabs Studio Voice & Focus Sticky Notes
releases.summary: Added ElevenLabs studio voice synthesis, Focus Timer & Stopwatch sticky notes, and live Windows media artwork integration.

highlights.title: ElevenLabs Studio Voice Engine
highlights.detail: Gapless HTML5 voice playback with configurable Gemini and ElevenLabs voices.

highlights.title: Interactive Focus Sticky Notes
highlights.detail: Pomodoro countdown timer, lap stopwatch, and tactile sticky notes docked right inside the notch.
